rules.name: recon-stuck-03-export-exposure
rules.sql: SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count, CASE WHEN r.row_count > 1048575 THEN 'over one Excel sheet' WHEN r.row_count > 500000 THEN 'large' WHEN r.row_count > 100000 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'normal' END AS size_band, round((r.row_count * 2494 / 1073741824.0)::numeric, 2) AS est_json_gib FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = p.published_run_id WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date >= :since ORDER BY r.row_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, l.status AS newest_run_status, l.requested_at AS newest_requested_at, left(l.error_message, 120) AS newest_error FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.uuid, r.status, r.requested_at, r.error_message FROM opera.recon_refresh_run r WHERE r.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND r.business_unit = p.business_unit AND r.view_type = p.view_type AND r.resolved_settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND r.status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) l ON true WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date >= :since AND l.uuid <> p.published_run_id AND l.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY l.requested_at DESC LIMIT 100

expect.reason: every published pointer leads to a COMPLETED run
no export reads an older run than the last refresh because that refresh is unfinished or failed
